subject: Re: RTO/RPO telemetry & tabletop artifacts request — evidence package and next steps
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novapay.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security@novapay.com
Date: 2026-11-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: RTO/RPO telemetry and tabletop artifacts request

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our internal review we need a short set of artifacts to close our BCP/DR line of inquiry for the SOW:

1) Recent RTO/RPO timing samples (last 90 days) for multi-region failover paths — token-level and KV warm timings.
2) Notes and output from the most recent tabletop (we run an audit next week).
3) Any runbook excerpt that shows the sequence for a regional failover and keystore restore (high level).
4) An index of retained logs/telemetry for a 30/90/365 day retention view (where applicable).

Can you provide these as a packaged export (CSV/JSON/PDF) by EOD PT on 2026-11-18? If live witness is required we can arrange a 30–45 minute session during the week of 11/22.

Also attached is a short vendor questionnaire (we flagged a couple of items for follow-up).

Thanks — Elena

Elena Ruiz
Senior Security Analyst, NovaPay
elena.ruiz@novapay.com
[Attachment: nova-vendor-questionnaire-BCP.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novapay.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO telemetry and tabletop artifacts request

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We'll assemble an evidence bundle for NP-2026-119 and aim for the 11/18 EOD PT deadline.

Quick internal plan: Ben will pull the RTO/RPO timing samples and KV warm traces, Kimberly will attach the SOC2/RTO attestation excerpts and runbook snippets, Naomi will build the exported index and retention notes.

Couple clarifying Qs (Ben/Naomi/Kimberly, please advise if I'm missing anything):
- Elena: do you want raw token-level traces or aggregated percentiles (p50/p90/p99) + a few raw samples for context?
- Any required redaction rules for IP addresses or customer identifiers?

We can deliver both aggregated CSVs and a small set of redacted raw samples if that helps.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
[Redwood Inference | www.redwood.ai]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-11T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO telemetry and tabletop artifacts request

Jonas / team — I'll take the raw telemetry and produce:
- rto-rpo-timelines.csv (p50/p90/p99 by region + per-request samples)
- kv-warm-cache-samples.json (5 redacted traces showing warm-cache latencies)
- a short README describing aggregation method and how we derived percentiles

Elena: for redaction we typically remove full request payloads and hash any customer IDs; IPs can be masked (x.x.x.0). We'll include the redaction notes in the README.

Estimate: I can have the CSV+JSON+README ready by 11/17 EOD PT to allow QA and final packaging on 11/18. If NovaPay needs raw unredacted samples for internal auditors we will need a signed DPA addendum — please advise.

Ben Carter
Head of Production Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample-kv-trace-stub.txt (text/plain)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO telemetry and tabletop artifacts request

Adding the runbook excerpts and the tabletop notes:
- tabletop-exercise-notes-2026-10-28.pdf (redacted facilitator notes + timeline)
- runbook-failover-sequence-snippet.txt (high-level steps for region failover & keystore restore)
- s3-presigned-manifest.txt (manifest of exported artifacts with checksums)

Also linking our SOC2 control mapping for DR (public excerpt) that maps to RTO/RPO responsibilities.

Related link for internal reviewers: https://drive.redwood.example.com/teams/ops/rto-rpo-evidence/NP-2026-119

Kimberly Park
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novapay.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-18T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO telemetry and tabletop artifacts request

Hi Elena — attached is the evidence bundle for NovaPay (NP-2026-119). Summary below and attached artifacts.

What we included:
- rto-rpo-timelines.csv (aggregates: p50/p90/p99 by region; includes 10 redacted raw samples)
- kv-warm-cache-samples.json (5 redacted traces)
- tabletop-exercise-notes-2026-10-28.pdf (redacted facilitator notes)
- runbook-failover-sequence-snippet.txt (high-level, non-sensitive steps)
- s3-presigned-manifest.txt (checksums + file list)

Notes:
- All telemetry was redacted per our standard policy (hashed IDs, masked IP octets). If NovaPay needs unredacted artifacts for auditors, we can provide them under a DPA addendum and mutually agreed secure transfer.
- We can host a live witness run-through of the failover sequence and telemetry digestion on 11/23 or 11/24 — available windows 10:00–12:00 PT.

Links & next steps:
- Evidence bundle (read-only): https://drive.redwood.example.com/teams/ops/rto-rpo-evidence/NP-2026-119
- Please confirm receipt and whether you want a live witness. If you need additional aggregation (e.g., 365-day percentile rollups) we can include that in a follow-up.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
[Attachment: rto-rpo-timelines.csv (text/csv), kv-warm-cache-samples.json (application/json), tabletop-exercise-notes-2026-10-28.pdf (application/pdf), runbook-failover-sequence-snippet.txt (text/plain), s3-presigned-manifest.txt (text/plain)]
